This is the current painting with the mosaic's intensity, not a return to mosaic materials.

Keep every shape, object, position, relative size, curve and silhouette from image 1: same near-circular outline; same off-centre white light, rays, curling wave, lower fish, right-side branching life and upper-right bird. Do not add details or redesign. Preserve true alpha transparency outside the silhouette and clean its boundary of any stray detached flecks. No external halo, paper rectangle, border, text, signature or watermark. One finished icon, not a comparison sheet.
